integrity: The new assertion is the exact planar pathwise exponent, its optimum and sharp boundary; the earlier mean-square recursion and general LMS pathwise/moment separation are openly attributed to prior literature.
scientific_limitations: Two coordinates, independent isotropic Gaussian rank-one directions, constant coefficient, deterministic nonzero initial error, stationary exact target, and no additive noise or arithmetic roundoff. Pathwise stability cannot replace full-algorithm moment guarantees.
title: The exact almost-sure stability frontier of planar Gaussian residual tracking
